name: Archival Document
abstract: A digital-representation profile constrained to archival document formats (PDF/A, LIDO/XML), with a mandatory persistent identifier for long-term archival reference.
description:
## Archival Document

An `ArchivalDocument` is a [`digital-representation`](../digital-representation) constrained to
archival document formats — PDF/A or LIDO/XML — covering D8.2 profile C (long-term archival and
metadata-exchange records).

Unlike the other digital-representation profiles, `persistentIdentifier` is **mandatory** here:
archival records are expected to be citable and durably resolvable, which is the whole point of
migrating a legacy paper or filesystem archive into this model (UC-V-3).

examples.title: A LIDO/XML catalogue record with a Handle PID
examples.content: A LIDO/XML export of the fishing creel's catalogue record, migrated from a legacy archive (UC-V-3) and minted with a persistent Handle.

examples.title: CAD/DWG architectural plan from Malta (HM-08)
examples.content: A ground floor plan of Villa Portelli, held as an AutoCAD DWG file (`application/dwg`), minted with a Handle persistent identifier and accessible via a download URL. Attributed to the Heritage Malta conservation department. Covers HM-08 (CAD/DWG architectural drawings of heritage buildings).

annotatedSchema:
$schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
title: Archival Document
description: "A `digital-representation` constrained to archival document formats
  \u2014 PDF/A or LIDO/XML \u2014 with\na mandatory persistent identifier, for long-term
  archival reference (D8.2 profile C).\n"
allOf:
- $ref: https://ogcincubator.github.io/bblocks-heritage/build/annotated/heritage/digital-representation/schema.yaml
- type: object
  required:
  - mediaType
  - persistentIdentifier
  properties:
    mediaType:
      type: string
      enum:
      - application/pdf
      - text/xml
      - application/dwg
      - image/vnd.dxf
      description: '`application/pdf` for a PDF/A document (ISO 19005), `text/xml`
        for a LIDO/XML record, `application/dwg` for an AutoCAD DWG architectural
        drawing, or `image/vnd.dxf` for a DXF drawing exchange file.'
